title: NDF-core v1.0.0
description: NORMORDIS Document Format — NDF-core structure. Canonical JSON object subject to JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalisation and CAdES-B-LTA signing.

ndf_version.description: NDF specification version (SemVer 2.0.0). Normative value for this schema: '1.0.0'.

ndf_id.description: Permanent document identifier. UUID v4 (RFC 9562). Generated before canonicalisation, immutable after finalisation.

estado.description: Document state at time of finalisation. Always 'ativo' in the NDF-core — immutable, signed. Archival lifecycle transitions (substituido, em_conservacao, etc.) are managed by the custodian system outside the NDF-core. See SPEC.md §2.4.

payload_hash_alg.description: Hash algorithm used to compute payload_hash. Normative value for NDF v1.x: 'sha256' (NIST FIPS 180-4).

nivel_assinatura.description: Minimum electronic signature level required by the legal nature of the act. See SPEC.md §2.10.

ndt_version_ref.description: NDT version reference. Format: '<schema_id>@<versao_ndt>'. Must be resolvable in the .ndfpkg or a compliant registry.

metadados.description: Descriptive metadata, GDPR fields, and document type reference. See SPEC.md §2.7.

documento.description: Document logical content. Structure is opaque at NDF-core level; validated by the schema referenced in metadados.tipo_documento_ref.

tipo_documento_ref.description: Versioned reference to the document type schema. Format: '<id>@<versao>'.

designacao.description: Official name of the producing entity.

codigo_dglab.description: DGLAB institutional code for archival context (MEG).

assunto.description: Document title or brief description — indexable.

idioma.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to 'pt' when absent.

classificacao_seguranca.description: Information security classification (DL n.º 11/2023). Defaults to 'uso_interno' when absent.

contem_dados_pessoais.description: True if the document contains personal data as defined by GDPR.

categorias_dados_pessoais.description: Required when contem_dados_pessoais is true. Open enum: 'identificacao_fiscal', 'rendimentos', 'saude', 'dados_processuais', 'biometricos', 'outros'.

base_legal_conservacao.description: Required when contem_dados_pessoais is true. Legal basis for conservation under GDPR Art. 6.

responsavel_tratamento.description: Name of the data controller (GDPR Art. 13-14). Required even when contem_dados_pessoais is false.

tipo_classificacao_ref.description: Reference to the archival class/series. Format: '<instrumento>/<codigo_classe>'. See SPEC.md §3.2.1.

forma_contagem_detalhe.description: Required when forma_contagem is 'outro'. Free-text description.

destino_final.description: Final disposition after PCA. See SPEC.md §3.4.

instrumento_avaliacao_versao_ref.description: Instrument and version used to resolve PCA/DF at finalisation time. Format: '<instrumento>/<versao>'. See SPEC.md §3.2.2.
